blocks.text: Bu ders kurallar ve tavsiyelerle ilgili: «kimlik göstermesi gerekiyor», «sözleşmeyi okumam lazım», «bir öğretmene danışmalısın», «kuralları çiğneyemezsin», «malzeme almak zorunda değilim». En önemlisi: «yasak» ile «zorunda değil»i karıştırmamak.

examples.en: I have to read the contract.
I don't have to buy supplies.

blocks.text: must + sözlükteki hâliyle eylem — «-meli», «mutlaka»: You must take your belongings. Türkçe ek kişiye göre değişir, must değişmez: -s yok, ve sonrasında asla to gelmez.

examples.en: We must check the expiry date.

fixes.wrong: You must to take your belongings.

drill.why: must'tan sonra eylem sözlükteki hâliyle gelir: -s yok, to yok.

blocks.text: have to + eylem — «zorundayım», «lazım», çoğu zaman şartlar yüzünden: I have to read the contract. he / she ile has to. to olmadan anlam değişir: I have read — «okudum».

formula.text: I / you / we / they: have to + eylem

examples.en: I have to read the contract.
She has to enter her occupation.
I occasionally have to work late.
examples.translation: Ara sıra geç saate kadar çalışmak zorunda kalıyorum.

examples.en: He has to follow the diversion.
I have to show proof of purchase.

fixes.wrong: I has to read the contract.
fixes.right: I have to read the contract.

fixes.wrong: She have to enter her occupation.
fixes.right: She has to enter her occupation.

blocks.text: should + eylem bir tavsiyedir: «-malısın», «iyi olur». You should consult a teacher. should de -s ve to almaz.

examples.en: We should use up the milk.

fixes.wrong: You should to consult a teacher.

blocks.text: ought to da tavsiye, neredeyse should gibi, ama to ile: You ought to set a budget — «bir bütçe yapman gerekir». Burada to şart, -s yok.

examples.en: You ought to set a budget.
We ought to find the cause.
You ought to keep in mind the departure time.
We ought to express our gratitude.

fixes.wrong: You ought read the national news.
fixes.right: You ought to read the national news.

fixes.wrong: You oughts to read the national news.
fixes.right: You ought to read the national news.

drill.why: ought'tan sonra hep to gelir; should ve must'ta yok.

blocks.text: mustn't bir yasaktır: «-memelisin», «asla». You mustn't ignore the rules. Dikkat: «zorunda değilsin» mustn't değil, don't have to'dur. mustn't'tan sonra eylem to'suz gelir.

fixes.wrong: You mustn't to ignore the rules.

sections.title: don't have to ve needn't — «zorunda değil»

blocks.text: «Zorunda değilsin, gerek yok» — don't / doesn't have to ya da needn't: I don't have to buy supplies; You needn't reply straight away. Bu yasak değil! Yasak mustn't. needn't'tan sonra to yok, don't have'den sonra var.

formula.text: zorunda değil: don't / doesn't have to + eylem

examples.en: I don't have to buy supplies.
She doesn't have to bring a photocopy.
He doesn't have to head back yet.

fixes.wrong: She don't have to bring a photocopy.
fixes.right: She doesn't have to bring a photocopy.

fixes.wrong: I don't has to buy supplies.
fixes.right: I don't have to buy supplies.

fixes.wrong: You needn't to collect it personally.

drill.question: Atölyede boyaları düzenleyen veriyor. Almak zorunda değilsin ama yasak da değil. Ne dersin?
drill.optionB: I don't have to buy supplies.
drill.explain: «Zorunda değilim» — don't have to. mustn't «yasak» demek.

blocks.text: 19. dersteki kibar rica burada da var: Could I pay separately? — «ayrı ödeyebilir miyim?». Önce Could, sonra I ve to'suz eylem.

examples.en: Could I send it by post?

fixes.wrong: I has to read the contract.
fixes.right: I have to read the contract.

fixes.wrong: You ought read the national news.
fixes.right: You ought to read the national news.

fixes.wrong: You needn't to collect it personally.

blocks.text: to yalnızca have to ve ought to'da var. must, should, mustn't ve needn't'tan sonra hemen eylem gelir. Yasak — mustn't, zorunda değil — don't have to ya da needn't.
Mutlaka — must. Zorundayım — have / has to. Tavsiye — should ya da ought to. Yasak — mustn't. Gerek yok — don't have to ya da needn't.

examples.en: We must go through the list.
He should stand up for his friend.
